node.title: M720 residual slice metadata
node.statement: Under the Modal count-ceiling window rule, every h=7..20 residual cell beyond the WSL-safe complete zero cells is either a W<n window slice or one of exactly two over-ceiling complete-window cells: n=32,h=16 at q~n^2 and q~n^3.
node.attack_surface: mechanical replay of the Modal window-selection rule over the configured h,n,q_exp grid
node.falsifier: a residual configured cell that is complete, under ceiling, and not already in the WSL-safe complete-cell list
